description: Apple's iOS 27.2.1 security update has reportedly failed to address the worse_query vulnerability, which could allow malicious applications to access files belonging to other apps. The researcher who discovered the flaw confirmed that it remained unpatched in the latest stable release and the first iOS 27.3 beta. The disclosure has raised concerns among cryptocurrency users after Binance warned that the vulnerability could expose wallet recovery phrases, private keys, and login credentials stored on affected devices.
title: Apple Leaves Crypto Wallet Security Bug Unresolved in Latest iOS Update

description: Oppo's reported decision to pause development of the Find X10 Ultra may lead to some of its components being used in the Find X11 Pro Max. Recent leaks suggest the handset could feature a 6.89-inch BOE display, a 100-megapixel square selfie camera and two 200-megapixel rear cameras. However, the 10x periscope camera may not make the transition. Tipsters have also suggested that Oppo could use the hardware in another flagship or an upcoming OnePlus smartphone instead of the Find X11 Pro Max.
title: Oppo Find X11 Pro Max Could Borrow Flagship Features From the Cancelled Find X10 Ultra

description: OpenAI today announced local processing and inference for the OpenAI API in India. This allows businesses and users to process supported AI requests within the country. Available initially for the GPT-6 Luna model, this offering builds on OpenAI’s existing data residency options in India. The new move is expected to be useful for customers in financial services with specific localisation requirements.
title: OpenAI Introduces Local API Processing in India for Eligible Businesses and Developers

description: Tron, Tether, and blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis have launched the Digital Crime Task Force to identify and disrupt cryptocurrency-related financial crimes. The initiative will focus on suspicious USDT transactions on the Tron network, with partners sharing intelligence, identifying criminal wallets, and supporting law enforcement efforts to freeze illicit funds. Its scope includes investment and romance scams, exchange hacks, terrorist financing, and cryptocurrency thefts linked to North Korean hackers. The launch follows the conclusion of the companies' earlier collaboration with TRM Labs.
title: Tron, Tether and Chainalysis Set Up Joint Task Force to Counter AI Crypto Fraud

description: Five wallpapers reportedly intended for Samsung's Galaxy S27 series have appeared in firmware files, suggesting Burgundy, Cream, Dark Blue, Light Blue and Pink colour options. The images share a ribbon-shaped design and appear to be static backgrounds. Samsung could offer some finishes exclusively through its online store or limit them to certain models. Separately, leaked dummy units suggest the Galaxy S27 Ultra and Pro could feature horizontal rear camera modules. The upcoming lineup is expected to debut in early 2027.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Series Stock Wallpapers Spotted in Firmware Files, Hint at Possible Colourways

description: Naughty Dog's Neil Druckmann has said that Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet has entered the "last stage of production". The studio head confirmed that gameplay and more story details from the sci-fi title will be revealed in 2027. Intergalactic is believed to be targeting launch next year, as well. The game was revealed at The Game Awards 2024.
title: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet in 'Last Stage of Production', Gameplay Reveal Coming Next Year

description: The Vivo X500 series is all set to launch in India soon, following its debut in China and global markets recently. The rumour mill suggests that the company is developing another smartphone that could join the lineup. A tipster now claims that the purported handset, dubbed the Vivo X500s, could sport a 6.85-inch LTPO display. It is tipped to be powered by a next-generation MediaTek Dimensity 9-series chipset, while also packing a larger battery than its predecessor.
title: Vivo X500s Tipped to Pack 64-Megapixel Periscope Camera, Dimensity 9-Series Chip

description: Oppo has confirmed key specifications of the Reno 17 and Reno 17 Pro ahead of their China launch. The two phones will feature different Qualcomm and MediaTek chipsets, dedicated touch and communication chips, and support for 120fps gaming. They will also run ColorOS 17 based on Android 17, with Oppo promising up to six years of smooth performance. The lineup will debut on November 16 alongside the Pad Air 6 and Watch 5.
title: Oppo Reno 17 Series Chipsets, Key Features Confirmed Ahead of November 16 Launch

description: Realme has announced the expansion of the after-sales service network in India. It is expanding its existing after-sales service network to more than 670 centres in over 550 Indian cities. The expansion is scheduled to come into force on November 16. The tech firm said that it has tapped Oppo’s existing after-sales infrastructure to expand its presence in the country. After the transition, Realme devices will also be serviced and repaired at Oppo service centres in India, along with its after-sales touchpoints. The company also announced that the expansion will result in a larger professional technical workforce with more than 1,500 certified engineers to look after Realme devices.
title: Realme to Expand Its After-Sales Service Network to Over 670 Centres in India With Oppo’s Existing Infrastructure

description: Samsung Galaxy S27+, Galaxy S27 Pro, and Galaxy S27 Ultra dummy units have been spotted in leaked images, revealing their design. The image shows the three handsets with a flat rear panel. The Ultra and Pro models could sport a horizontal rear camera module with four camera cutouts, while missing an LED flash. On the other hand, the Samsung Galaxy S27+ appears with a familiar design, featuring a vertically aligned triple rear camera unit, placed next to an LED flash. The camera cutouts have been placed on top of a raised platform, similar to the phone’s predecessor. The dummy units seem to miss out on the physical buttons or other cutouts. An unspecified cutout appears between two camera sensors on the back of the Galaxy S27 Ultra and Galaxy S27 Pro, which could house the secondary microphone.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra, Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27+ Leaked Dummy Unit Images Suggest Significant Design Overhaul

description: Microsoft Bing has introduced a new way for users to control whether they see AI-generated answers while searching on the web. According to the company, users will have the option to switch between AI-powered summaries and traditional search results, depending on their preferences. The feature is said to be available through a new browser extension for Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge. Microsoft says users can also avoid AI-generated answers without installing an extension by adding a specific search operator to their queries.
title: Microsoft Bing’s New Extension Brings Back Traditional Search, Lets Users Turn Off AI Answers

description: Samsung Galaxy Tab A11+ was launched in November last year with an 11-inch TFT LCD screen and a MediaTek MT8775 chipset. A new leak suggests that Galaxy Tab A11+ prices in India could increase by Rs. 3,000. The prices of all four RAM and storage configurations of the tablet have reportedly been increased.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab A11+ Price in India Reportedly Hiked by Rs. 3,000

description: WhatsApp is extending its disappearing message controls beyond photos, videos and voice notes. The new option lets users send text that recipients can open only once, with the app restricting screenshots, screen recordings, copying and forwarding. WABetaInfo spotted the feature in Android beta version 2.26.45.6. Users can activate it by holding down the send button in a chat. WhatsApp has also added an indicator to show when someone has opened a message, while read receipts let senders check whether it has been viewed.
title: WhatsApp View Once Text Messages Reportedly Rolling Out to Android Beta Testers

description: Samsung is said to be working on two new rugged smartphones as part of its next-generation Galaxy XCover lineup. According to a report, the South Korean tech conglomerate is working on Galaxy XCover 8 and Galaxy XCover FR/Scan. The purported handsets have reportedly surfaced in trade databases, revealing some of their key specifications. The Galaxy XCover 8 is expected to succeed the Galaxy XCover 7, while the Galaxy XCover FR/Scan could offer RFID scanning features and enterprise-focused hardware.
title: Samsung Galaxy XCover 8, XCover FR/Scan Camera Specifications Reportedly Leaked

description: Samsung is reportedly working on an interface change for its Phone app with the upcoming One UI 9.5 update. The new software version could relocate the search button from the top of the screen to the bottom navigation bar. The change was spotted in a leaked version of Samsung's Phone app. The company is reportedly making a few adjustments to the search interface itself in One UI 9.5.
title: Samsung One UI 9.5 Update Said to Offer Redesigned Search Button for Phone App

description: Vu Masterpiece AEye TV series was launched in India on Thursday. The company claims its latest range features RGB MiniLED displays, AI-based picture processing, and an ambient light sensor for automatic brightness adjustments. The new TV lineup is available in six screen sizes, ranging from 55 inches to 115 inches. It offers up to 3,000 nits of peak brightness, up to 2,696 local dimming zones, and 288Hz motion processing. The Vu Masterpiece AEye TV series also comes with a 360-degree surround sound system with up to 240W output, Dolby Atmos support, and Google TV with Gemini AI.
title: Vu Masterpiece AEye TV Series Launched in India With RGB MiniLED Displays, Dolby Atmos Support: Price, Specifications

description: Xiaomi is reportedly testing a fourth Redmi K100 handset according to a reliable tipster. After launching the Redmi K100, K100 Pro and K100 Pro Max models in China, Xiaomi is reportedly working on a K100 Ultra model, which will be equipped with premium hardware like a 2nm chipset.
title: Redmi K100 Ultra Specifications Leak; Could Pack a 2nm Chipset and 10,000mAh Battery and More

description: Google is using its new Gemini Decisions API in products such as Gemini Notebook, Stitch and Google Search. The technology helps Gemini Notebook select models and thinking levels for incoming queries, while other applications use it for product design, emoji suggestions and security checks. Google says its use in Gemini Notebook has reduced latency for everyday requests by up to 40 percent. Developers can access the API through Google AI Studio, with paid usage starting at $0.10 (roughly Rs. 9.39) per million input tokens.
title: Google Gemini Decisions API Debuts With Support for 1,000 Questions Per Request

description: Suiet, a non-custodial wallet for the Sui blockchain, has announced that it will discontinue its services, adding to a series of project exits from the ecosystem. The decision comes amid declining DeFi activity and a drop in Sui's total value locked and active daily users. Other projects, including Suiball, Phantom, and Full Sail, have also discontinued or suspended their Sui-related services. Despite the decline in active users, monthly transaction numbers on the network have increased.
title: Suiet Wallet Calls It Quits, Marking Another Exit From Sui Ecosystem

description: OpenAI has expanded ChatGPT Finances to the desktop app. The feature was launched earlier this year.   The feature allows users to connect their financial accounts to find ways to save, understand their spending, and make sense of their investments. ChatGPT Finances on desktop is available to Free, Go, Plus and Pro users in the US.
title: ChatGPT Finances Now Available on Mac, Lets Users Track Spending, Savings and More

description: Xiaomi will launch multiple devices on November 17, along with the Xiaomi 18 Pro series, the company has announced. The company has confirmed that the event will witness the global debut of the Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm, Xiaomi Smart Band 11, Xiaomi Clip TWS, Mijia Tri Drum Washer Dryer Pro 12kg, Mijia Refrigerator Pro Multi Door 546L, Xiaomi Robot Vacuum 6 Max, and Mijia Vacuum Cleaner 4 Max. Most of these devices have already been launched in China, including the wearables. The company has revealed the design of the upcoming devices. The Xiaomi Smart Band 11 will sport a pill-shaped display. The fitness tracker will also ship with a silicone strap.
title: Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm, Xiaomi Clip and Mijia Smart Home Appliances to Launch Next Week Alongside Xiaomi 18 Pro Series

description: Development on Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra is still ongoing, Skydance Games has clarified after rumours that claimed the project was cancelled. The studio reportedly assured the development team that the game had not been cancelled. Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra has been delayed multiple times and has reportedly shrunk in scope over the years.
title: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra Still in Development, Skydance Games Says After Cancellation Rumours

description: Reddit has long been a popular destination for people looking for honest opinions before buying a product. In an attempt to make the research process quicker, the platform recently introduced Reddit Reviews as an AI-powered feature that summarises conversations about products and categories. The move, however, does not seem to have gone down well with a section of its community, with several users and subreddit moderators criticising the new feature.
title: 'Not a Single Person Who Uses Reddit Wants This': Users Slam New Reddit Reviews Feature

description: After launching the Vivo X500 series in China, the company is now geared up to bring its Vivo X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max to India. A recent teaser by the brand revealed that Vivo would also bring its Telephoto Extender Gen 2 lens and Watch GT2 to India. Now, tipster has finally revealed the alleged launch timeline along with the expected sale date.
title: Vivo X500 Series, Zeiss Extender Gen 2 and Watch GT2 India Launch Timeline Leaked

description: India's offline smartphone market is said to have witnessed a subdued Diwali festive season. A new report suggests that handset sales volumes fell, with steady footfall at retail stores. While several brands, including Apple and Motorola, reportedly saw healthy demand, others are said to have struggled to convert festive interest into sales. Retailers have also flagged growing differences between online and offline prices, which they say are affecting traditional distribution channels.
title: Diwali Smartphone Sales Reportedly Decline 20 Percent as Rising Prices Hit Consumer Demand

description: iQOO 16 could be launched in India soon as the second addition to the company's flagship iQOO 16 series, according to a report. The phone has been listed on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) website with the model number I2606. The iQOO smartphone was earlier spotted on Malaysia’s SIRIM certification database with the same model. However, the handset is expected to launch in select global markets outside India and China as the iQOO 16s. The smartphone will reportedly be powered by an unreleased Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 chipset from Qualcomm, which might sit below the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 SoCs.
title: iQOO 16R India Launch Seemingly Confirmed as Phone Receives Key Regulatory Certification

description: Bitcoin and Ethereum traded lower on Thursday as cryptocurrency markets remained cautious despite stronger US equities and declining market volatility. Bitcoin continued to struggle below $74,000, with analysts identifying $73,000 as a crucial support level and $75,000-$76,000 as the recovery range. Institutional demand and Federal Reserve policy expectations remain key factors influencing market sentiment
title: Bitcoin Fails to Reclaim $75,000 as Broader Crypto Market Sentiment Remains Weak

description: Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max will be launched in India on November 26, along with the new Vivo Watch GT 2 and the Zeiss telephoto converter kit, the company has announced. The company has also revealed that the standard model will sport a “floating camera module” with a Zeiss-tuned imaging solution. The handset will also feature AI-powered creative tools. Meanwhile, the Vivo X500 Pro Max and Vivo X500 Pro will carry a Zeiss-tuned triple rear camera unit, housed inside a circular deco. The Pro Max model will feature Telephoto AF Tracking Video and the ZEISS TrueDynamic Main Camera, the company announced. On the other hand, the Vivo Watch GT 2 is confirmed to sport a 2.07-inch Ultra-Vision Display with always-on monitoring. The smartwatch is claimed to deliver up to 25 days of battery life.
title: Vivo X500 Series India Launch Date Announced; Will Debut Alongside Vivo Watch GT 2, Zeiss Telephoto Converter Kit

description: Google Labs announced a new experimental tool on Wednesday to help make group planning and collaboration more interactive. According to the Mountain View-based tech giant, the new Tabletop experience lets users turn links, files and ideas into customisable spaces where multiple people can contribute in real time. Google says it can be used for a wide range of activities, from organising family trips and splitting expenses to creating dinner polls, tournament brackets and household chore lists.
title: Google Labs Launches Tabletop as an AI-Powered Collaborative Tool for Trips, Games and Group Activities

description: Google confirmed that it will soon bring proactive suggestions to Android Auto, connecting the dots across your apps to surface helpful, personalised suggestions. It will be available on Pixel phones with Gemini Intelligence. For example, if your friend texts you to ask where you are meeting for a Pilates class, Gemini Intelligence on Android Auto can find your confirmation email and instantly suggest sending the address with a single tap. Google has not announced a specific release date for the Android Auto integration.
title: Google Announces Gemini Intelligence for Android Auto With Proactive AI Suggestions

description: Apple is all set to discontinue its Apple Support Community platform after nearly three decades. The company has stopped accepting new posts on the website, and it has transitioned to read-only mode. According to a notice displayed on the platform, the forums will be permanently discontinued on November 20, 2026. The platform previously helped users to troubleshoot issues and exchange information about its products.
title: Apple Support Community to Shut Down Later This Month After Nearly 30 Years

description: The Vivo Watch GT 2 could arrive in India in Black and Off White colour options, according to a new leak. Its expected specifications include a 2.07-inch AMOLED display with up to 2,400 nits peak brightness and up to 25 days of battery life. The China models offer health tracking, more than 100 sports modes, Bluetooth 5.4 and GPS. Vivo has not confirmed the India variant's specifications, including its battery capacity or whether it will get Bluetooth and eSIM versions.
title: Vivo Watch GT 2 India Variant Key Specifications, Colour Options Leaked Ahead of Launch

description: Sony has announced that PlayStation 5 has sold over 100 million units. The console has reached the sales milestone in six years after it launched in November 2020. The upcoming launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 has handed a boost to PS5 sales. However, overall sales of the console have been on the decline.
title: PS5 Lifetime Sales Surpass 100 Million Units Days Before GTA 6 Launch

description: ACT Fibernet has reportedly introduced a new limited-time promotional Diwali offer. ACT Fibernet is reportedly allowing customers to upgrade to a faster internet band without paying an extra charge. The company has introduced a tier-based structure for this. ACT Fibernet customers with a sub-100Mbps connection will be upgraded to the 100Mbps connection. Meanwhile, ACT Fibernet subscribers who pay for the 100Mbps to 299Mbps broadband plans will be upgraded to the 300Mbps download speed. Lastly, customers with a plan offering between 300 Mbps and 499 Mbps internet speeds will be elevated to 500Mbps download speeds.
title: ACT Fibernet Diwali Offer Allows Customers to Upgrade to Faster Broadband Plans at No Additional Cost: Report

description: Oppo A7 Ultra will be launched in China in December, according to a tipster. The smartphone is tipped to be equipped with a 12,000mAh battery. It will reportedly sport a “large horizontal matrix design”. The leaker is likely referring to the smartphone that was recently spotted on the Telecommunication Equipment Certification Center (TENAA) website with the model number PNC110. The listing contained images of the upcoming phone, revealing its design. The India launch of the handset remains uncertain. The purported Oppo A7 Ultra was spotted with a flat rear panel. The smartphone might feature a horizontally aligned rectangular camera module with three cutouts placed on the left side and an LED flash on the right side, along with the “AI Camera” branding.
title: Oppo A7 Ultra Will Launch Next Month With 12,000mAh Battery, Tipster Claims
